findings.message: The case assumes that warehouse_operator can approve an order successfully, but the requirement limits approval to sales_manager; the authorization outcome for warehouse_operator is not supplied and cannot be invented.
evidence: TC-AUTH-001.steps[0].expected_result=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
